description: This file defines a utility class TemplateFunctions with a static method now() that returns the current date and time formatted as 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm'. It serves as a helper within the Fineract project for date formatting.

classes.name: TemplateFunctions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods related to date/time formatting.

methods.name: now
